scope: P03/P04 pre-execution approval persistence, not execution or multiuser acceptance
defect: separate action/audit saves could grant in-memory execution eligibility after failed save or persist approval despite an audit failure response
fix: commitApproval restricts the two existing authorization transitions and saves their action state plus audit together; failure restores held action references and events

tests.effects: synthetic queue/approval only; no execution endpoint, provider calls or external actions
tests.reopen: failed final confirmation remains awaiting confirmation after reopening; same token retries safely once storage works; audit exactly once

source_integrity.policy_diff: approveCommand and confirm only; executed path unchanged

live_readonly.meaning: release-state check only; no new memory, OOM, checkpoint or backup verification

limits: single-process JSON store; no fsync/power-loss guarantee
does not make all mutators transactional
commit-before-response crash recovery still requires review
no change to uncertain external-effect handling or generic updateAction
current technical mono-user guard is not future Odoo multiuser authorization
acceptance: F0/F1/F2, four end-to-end paths and live recovery remain open;4.5.1 remains accepted
production_effects: no main push, merge, deploy, restart, hosted migration, Odoo mutation, send, payment or purchase
